summary: RETEST of the iteration_69 typography/layout regressions. FRONTEND ONLY, Expo web preview at 390x844, 375x667, 320x568 and 768x1024, using the DOM overflow audit (screenshots_iter70/audit.js), per-element measurements (measure.js) and screenshots. FIXED: HIGH-1 overflow (Button content now stays inside the pill and the icon is never cut). HIGH-2 left-edge cut (coin icon fully visible). HIGH-4 (nb-friends-row scrolls horizontally, nb-add-friend can be reached and tapped at 390/375/320 and opens /neighbours/find-friends). MED-6 (basket and saved buttons on-screen and tappable at 320; at 390 the location pill shows 'All of Nigeria' in full). MED-7 (Pointek 'Manufacturer warran…' stays inside the card with ellipsis). Agent-dashboard pills wrap to a second row. Profile stat tiles and the inbox placeholder are fine. Tablet home and passport are clean. No console errors. STILL BROKEN or NEW: (1) HIGH-3 onboarding slide 4: the 3 bullet chips sit behind the fixed footer. At 375x667 only 1 of 3 chips shows; at 320x568 all 3 are hidden. Slides 1-3 are fine. (2) MED-8 is NOT fixed: shop prices still truncate at 320 ('From ₦12,389,…', and even ₦3,629,000) on /shop/category and /shop/search. Market deal-carousel cards truncate prices at BOTH 390 and 320 ('₦269,9…', strike-through '₦294,0…'). (3) NEW regression: on an owned listing's passport at 320 the sticky 'Manage' Button (book-tour-btn) shows only the icon plus 'M' (label is 12px wide). (4) Unlock prices are still hidden at 320: unlock-cta-btn reads 'Unlock for 1,200…' and home tiles read 'Unlock · 1,2…'. (5) At 320 the passport hero 'Premium' badge overlaps the '+4 photos · unlock' pill by about 70px; at 390 they touch. (6) MED-5 partly fixed: there is no mid-word wrap any more, but at 320 the titles are cut to 'Upda…' and 'neighbo…', and the 'Neighbours' tab label shows 'Neighbo…'. (7) The SCHOOLS ScorePill label is truncated at 390, and SCHOOLS and SAFETY are both truncated at 320. (8) The home search placeholder 'Search area or landmark' is still clipped at 390 (needs 209px, has 202). (9) The Button labels on /become-agent are heavily truncated: 'My re…' and 'Plans …' at 320, 'My represen…' at 390.

ui_bugs.issue: The bullet chips (MASS unlocks homes / FIX pays pros / Earn daily) render under the absolutely positioned footer. 375x667: chip row 1 top=459, row 2 top=507, but the dots start at 503 and Next at 525, so only the first chip is visible. 320x568: chips top=380 and 428 vs dots 404, so all three are hidden. Reserving 330pt is not enough when bullets are present.

At 320 the 'From' prefix and the price share a 140px card. The price box is capped at 99px but needs 113px for ₦12,389,000 and 102px for ₦3,629,000, so 'From ₦12,389,…' is shown. Seen on /shop/category/furniture and /shop/search.
The 168px-wide deal cards truncate the 23px price and the 15px strike-through price at BOTH 390 and 320: '₦269,9…' / '₦294,0…'.

NEW regression from the Button flexShrink change. At 320 the bar holds 3 icon buttons (54px each) plus a size='lg' Button (26px padding + 22px icon + 10px gap). The Button is 96px wide and its label collapses to 12px, so only the icon and 'M' show. The non-owner 'Chat · Free' variant uses the same layout and is probably affected too (not verified: no unlocked non-owned listing was available without spending MASS).

unlock-cta-btn title shows 'Unlock for 1,200…' at 320 (164px available), and home tile primary buttons show 'Unlock · 1,2…' at 320. The cost is the critical value and it is hidden. At 390 both are fine.
At 320 the Premium badge (x 108-211) overlaps the '+4 photos · unlock' pill (x 140-304). At 390 they touch (211 vs 210). Seen on locked listing f2342766.

updates-title truncates to 'Upda…' (22px, 76px available) and updates-subtitle to '2 unread …'. neighbours-title truncates to 'neighbo…' (30px, 136px available). There is no mid-word break any more, but the screen name is still unreadable. The 3 header icon buttons take the space; consider smaller icons or moving one into a menu below 360.
SCHOOLS is truncated at 390 (60px pill); SCHOOLS and SAFETY are both truncated at 320 (42px). adjustsFontSizeToFit is ignored on web.

No overflow any more, but the labels are mostly hidden: 'My represen…' / 'Plans & up…' at 390 and 'My re…' / 'Plans …' at 320. Suggest stacking them vertically below about 400px, or using shorter labels such as 'My reps' and 'Plans'.
'Search area or landmark' is still clipped at 390 ('…landmar'): 202px available, 209px needed. Use 'Search area or landmark' only at 400px and wider, or 'Search area'.
Shrinks to 71px and shows only 'A…'. The buttons stay reachable, but the pill gives no information; consider icon-only or a short name below 360.

integration_issues.issue: The Profile stat-unlocked tile shows 13 for demo, but /unlocks shows 'No unlocked properties yet'. This may be a data or count mismatch; not part of the typography task, flagged for awareness.

issues: The promo-badge-feature 'Featured · 14d left' is truncated at 390 (101px) and 320 (62px).
Header title 'My Unlocked Pro…' is truncated at 320.

action_items: HIGH onboarding.tsx: include the bullets height in the reserve when slide.bullets exists (about +100pt), or shrink heroH or hide the bullets below about 700pt of height, so that all 3 chips on slide 4 stay above the footer dots at 375x667 and 320x568.

HIGH ShopProductCard: at narrow card widths put 'From' on its own line above the price, or drop the price to about 16px below 360 / when the card is under 150px. The price must never truncate. Fix the market deal-carousel card too: widen it or cut the price to 19px and move the strike-through price to its own line; it truncates at 390 as well.

HIGH property/[id].tsx sticky CTA: below 360, shrink the CTA Button to size='md' or iconOnly, or remove one icon button (e.g. move share to the header), so 'Manage' and 'Chat · Free' keep their full label. Also consider a minWidth on the label inside Button.tsx so it can never fall below about 3 characters.
MEDIUM unlock-cta-btn and home-tile-primary at 320: use a shorter label ('Unlock · 1,200') or a smaller title variant so the MASS cost is always visible.
MEDIUM passport hero chip row: let the chips wrap, or hide the Premium chip / shorten '+4 photos · unlock' to '+4' below 360, so nothing overlaps.
MEDIUM Updates/Neighbours headers at 320: make the header icon buttons smaller (36px) or reduce the title font further so 'Updates' and 'neighbours' fit.

LOW: make the ScorePill labels fit (smaller letterSpacing/font, or 'SCHOOL'); shorten the home placeholder at 390; give the become-agent buttons shorter labels or stack them; at 320 make the location pill icon-only.
critical_code_review_comments: Button.tsx: label flexShrink:1 fixes the overflow but lets the label shrink to about 0 when the parent is narrow (book-tour-btn shows 'M'). Callers with flex:1 in crowded rows need a narrow-width variant, or Button should fall back to iconOnly when its width is below a threshold.

Several fixes rely on adjustsFontSizeToFit (homes-sheet-title, ScorePill, onboarding title), which RN-web ignores, so web always falls back to ellipsis. Explicit width-based font choices (as done for heroSm) are more reliable.

success_rate.frontend: about 55%: 6 of 11 retest items fully pass (HIGH-1 overflow, HIGH-2 icon, HIGH-4, MED-6, MED-7, LOW agent pills/stats/inbox); HIGH-3 slide 4, MED-8 and MED-5 fail or partly fail; 1 new HIGH regression

rca_of_issue: Onboarding: the footer (dots + Next + Sign in) is absolute, about 165pt tall, and the copy block starts at heroH. The 330pt reserve covers headline + subtitle but not the bullets block of about 100pt on slide 4. Prices: the price Text has numberOfLines=1 inside a row with the 'From' prefix and a fixed card width, so at 19-23px the number is wider than the space left. Manage CTA: the Button lg size has fixed padding (52px) + icon (22) + gap (10) = 84px of non-shrinkable content in a 96px slot.
